children: Milestone Pharmaceuticals announced NMPA approval of etripamil nasal spray for adult PSVT and a $2.0 million milestone payment.
China's NMPA approved etripamil nasal spray for treatment of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in adults.
Approval is first regulatory nod for etripamil outside the United States and triggers a $2.0 million payment to Milestone.
Everest Medicines has exclusive Greater China commercialization rights and will lead launch in the region.
Milestone may receive up to $98.0 million in additional milestones plus tiered royalties up to 18% on Greater China sales.
Approval was based on global Phase 3 RAPID and China Phase 3 JX02002 data; JX02002 met primary endpoint with significant conversion to sinus rhythm.
